annotations.title: Get Async Document Extraction Job Status & Result

description: Retrieve the lifecycle status (`PROCESSING`, `COMPLETED`, or `FAILED`), timestamps, and extracted JSON result of an asynchronous job previously created by `submit_document_job`. Requires the same user `api_key` that submitted the job; returns a not-found error for unknown or unauthorized `job_id` values. Read-only and consumes zero credits. Do NOT use to check service health or account credit balance (`get_smartocr_status`).

api_key.description: Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`) belonging to the account that created `job_id`. Falls back to `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` header.

name: get_document_job

completedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the job record was last updated.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the job was created.

result.description: Extracted JSON payload when `status` is `COMPLETED`, or error details when `FAILED`.
